title: Personal Sender Account Standing and the Bank Deposit Recall Fee
content:
On a Bank Deposit recall request, the recall standing share scales the recall fee basis according to the standing of the customer's Personal Sender Account: its level and how long it has been open.

## Clause

A customer whose Personal Sender Account is at Paloma Premier or above (level number 5 or higher) and has been open for at least 24 months pays the premier share, 50 percent of the recall fee basis; a customer whose account is at Paloma Verified Plus or Paloma Enhanced (level number 3 or 4) and has been open for at least 36 months pays the standing share, 70 percent of the recall fee basis; every other customer is not affected by this rule. Account tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the handling date, never from the date its current level took effect.

## Records read

The Personal Sender Account's current level and its opening date.

## Combinations

| Personal Sender Account level | Whole months open | Share of the recall fee basis paid |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Premier or Paloma Private Client (5 or higher) | 24 or more | 50 percent |
| Paloma Premier or Paloma Private Client (5 or higher) | fewer than 24 | not affected |
| Paloma Verified Plus or Paloma Enhanced (3 or 4) | 36 or more | 70 percent |
| Paloma Verified Plus or Paloma Enhanced (3 or 4) | fewer than 36 | not affected |
| Paloma Starter or Paloma Verified (1 or 2) | any | not affected |

## Hypothetical cases

- Paloma Premier, opened 30 whole months ago: 50 percent.
- Paloma Premier, opened 20 whole months ago: not 50 percent (under 24 months), and not 70 percent either, because the 70 percent row is for levels 3 and 4 only; not affected.
- Paloma Enhanced, opened 36 whole months ago: 70 percent (at the threshold).
- Paloma Enhanced, opened 35 whole months ago: not affected.
- An account opened 40 whole months ago that reached Paloma Verified Plus only 2 months ago: tenure is 40 months, counted from the opening date, so 70 percent.
